name: Karaoke Memorial DX
source:
Main character is a junior college student invited to a karaoke party. There are a lot of handsome men in there, so heroine can flirt with them and maybe even find true love there.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-may-2006-hidamari.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一名受邀参加卡拉OK派对的专科生。那里有很多帅哥，所以女主角可以和他们调情，甚至可能在那里找到真爱。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-may-2006-hidamari.html]vndbreview[/url]]
